acceptance_predicates.description: Omitted channel resolves to dev and reports the resolved channel and exact current-main provenance.
Explicit dev/stable/nightly/experimental values are parsed, with unavailable channels rejected clearly and without fallback.
Human-readable output is the default and --json emits stable structured results.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: ASB channel resolver and install/launch consumers are covered by focused tests and hosted checks.
Independent review confirms no silent channel fallback.

inputs.description: Explicit or omitted channel request and current-main provenance.

outputs.description: Resolved channel and actionable availability diagnostic.

gates.description: Resolver, CLI consumers, and output contract pass exact-head checks.
